# reverse_check_allowlist.txt — endpoint ids the OpenAPI document does not
# describe yet.
#
# TestSpecRouterConformance/manifest_reverse_check reads
# apps/elitea-web/src/shared/api/endpoints.manifest.json and requires every
# endpoint the new UI calls to be covered by api/openapi/v2.yaml. The ids below
# are the Wave-2 hand-written slices (source:"handwritten", operationId:null in
# the manifest). Spec §5.3 expects them to arrive in the document one by one.
#
# 93 -> 78 (issue 621). Fifteen lines went at once because the rule below could
# not fire until then: pathCoveredBySpec compared the manifest path, which has
# no server base, against `servers[0].url` + the document path, so the first
# segment compared "api" against the plugin name and NO hand-written entry ever
# matched. Nine of the fifteen — the whole secrets domain issue 151 described,
# the single-toolkit GET, and the two entity_settings writes — had been
# described for some time and the list still carried them. The other six are
# the two `/configurations/*` reads this change describes.
#
# RULES
# - The list may only shrink. Describe the endpoint in v2.yaml, then delete
#   its line here. The test fails on a line the spec now covers.
# - Do not add a line. A new endpoint that the spec does not describe must
#   fail the gate. maxAllowlistEntries in conformance_test.go pins the size.
#
# One id per line. `#` starts a comment.
applications.getPipelineTrigger
applications.updatePipelineTrigger
artifacts.artifactList
